creatures.name: Seth, Goblin
creatures.special: Quick (attacks and defence are DR14). Curse: if still alive d6 days after attacking you, you warp irrevocably into a goblin.

creatures.name: Bent, Scum
creatures.special: Poisoned knife (Toughness DR10 or infected). Highest Presence PC tests DR14 at start of battle or random PC takes backstab (+3 dmg).

creatures.name: Zukuma, Berserker
creatures.special: Wields (d4): 1 Long flail d8, 2 Heavy mace d6, 3 Chained sword d6, 4 Huge warhammer d10. Attacks twice per round; DR10 to hit them.

creatures.name: Wrat, Wraith
creatures.special: Always wins initiative. Difficult to hit (DR14). Touch drains Strength, Presence and Agility by 1 for the duration of the fight.

creatures.name: Belze, Blood-drenched Skeleton
creatures.special: Soundless surprise attack. Piercing weapons are DR14. Any strike doing 5 or more damage destroys the skeleton completely.

creatures.name: Lich, Undead (weak) Necromancer
creatures.special: Paralyzing touch (Presence DR14 every round to break free). No one can use Powers near it; can steal scroll contents each round.

creatures.name: Arbint, Troll
creatures.special: Easy to hit (DR10). Retreats if badly wounded and returns stronger (+d6 dmg, healed HP added to maxHP).

creatures.name: Nodh, Zombie
creatures.special: Anyone bitten tests Toughness DR8 or dies within two days before rising as a zombie.

creatures.name: Lady Porcelain, Undead Doll
creatures.special: Mad gaze demands Presence DR12 at start of combat to avoid being frozen with fear for d4 rounds.

creatures.name: Thinx, Grotesque
creatures.special: Easy to hit (DR10). Eye-beam (d8, always hits) is used on 1-2 on a d6 each round.

creatures.name: Aland, Wickhead Knife-wielder
creatures.special: 25% chance wounds become infected. Can magically douse nearby lights, ignite blinding light, attack, and vanish.

creatures.name: Eulotha, Wyvern
creatures.special: 60% chance she bites; 40% venomous tail sting (Toughness DR14 or 1 hour painful paralysis).
creatures.bounty: 200s Captured / 100s Corpse / 60s Poison gland / 60s Tail spike

creatures.name: Dusk Gnoum
creatures.special: Crawls from holes and climbs walls. Small, quick, frail (DR14 to hit).

creatures.name: Oily Mongrel
creatures.special: Massive black hound with shaggy oily fur. Bite inflicts infection if Toughness DR12 fails.

creatures.name: Guard with Sharpened Teeth
creatures.special: Weak, gaunt, and cannibalistic. Licks its lips before biting.

creatures.name: Crooked Guard
creatures.special: Memory-cursed watchman obeying the dungeon warlock. Carries iron keys.

creatures.name: Mad Prisoner
creatures.special: Emaciated and pleading, yet strangles anyone who draws too close (Strength DR12 to break free).

creatures.name: Nesting Death
creatures.special: Hound-sized spider nesting in ceiling bones. Wins initiative on 1-4 (d6). Bite forces Toughness DR12 or freezing (+2 DR for 1 hour).

creatures.name: Slumbering Skeleton
creatures.special: Thoughtless and without goal; awakens when tombs or bookshelves are looted.

creatures.name: Ragged Cult Zealot
creatures.special: Zealous host dressed in rags. Never retreats; chants in minor key.

creatures.name: Ruthless Bounty Hunter
creatures.special: Tracks fugitives, debtors, and deserting wretches across the Dying World.

creatures.name: Fletcher-Kin, Cannibal Warlock
creatures.special: BOSS: Burn inflicts -2 Agility for a day. Casts Power every 3rd round. When hit, human flesh rains down (Agility DR8 or d4 dmg). Death pacifies the Apex Beast.

creatures.name: Glass-Cult Archon
creatures.special: BOSS: Casts Power every 3rd round. When hit, glass shards burst from robes (Agility DR8 or d4 dmg). Death pacifies the Apex Beast.

creatures.name: Plague Alchemist
creatures.special: BOSS: Casts Power every 3rd round. When hit, boiling bile sprays (Agility DR8 or d4 dmg). Death pacifies the Apex Beast.

creatures.name: Blood Inquisitor
creatures.special: BOSS: Casts Power every 3rd round. When hit, ash and embers rain down (Agility DR8 or d4 dmg). Death pacifies the Apex Beast.

creatures.name: The Gutworm
creatures.special: APEX BEAST: Unfathomably long worm coiled in Rotblack Sludge. On hit, test Agility DR6 or be devoured instantly. Sinks dead/dreaming if Boss dies.

creatures.name: Abyssal Cistern-Maw
creatures.special: APEX BEAST: Blind eel-horror in the flooded depths. On hit, test Agility DR6 or be dragged under and devoured. Pacified if Boss dies.

creatures.name: Chasm-Weaver Horror
creatures.special: APEX BEAST: Vast centipede-spider bridging the bone chasm. On hit, test Agility DR6 or be pulled into the pit. Pacified if Boss dies.
